## R Markdown

```{r}
# Required libraries
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(glmmTMB)
library(DHARMa)
library(brms)
library(car)
library(bayesplot)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)
```


```{r}
# Import data
df_long <- read.csv("C:/Users/YASMEEN/Desktop/GITHUB/Mosquito_Climate_Analysis/abundance_data.csv")

# Summarise the Data
summary(df_long)

```


```{r}
# Exclude NAs
df_long <- na.omit(df_long)
```


```{r}
# Exploratory 

# Run a simple linear model
lm <- lm(mosquito_counts ~ Temp + Humidity + Rain_lag1 + sin_term + cos_term,
         data = df_long)

summary(lm)

# Check for collinearity among predictors
vif(lm)


# Correlation Plot
corr <- cor(df_long[, c("Temp", "Humidity", "Rain_lag1", "sin_term", "cos_term")])

corrplot(corr, method = "number")

```


```{r}
# Scale the Numeric predictors
df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(across(c(Temp, Humidity, Rain_lag1), 
                ~ as.vector(scale(.))))
```


```{r}
# Nested Models
model_1 <- glmmTMB(mosquito_counts ~ Location,
                 data = df_long, 
                 family = nbinom2)

model_2 <- glmmTMB(mosquito_counts ~ Temp + Location,
                 data = df_long, 
                 family = nbinom2)

model_3 <- glmmTMB(mosquito_counts ~ Temp + Humidity + Location,
                 data = df_long, 
                 family = nbinom2)

model_4 <- glmmTMB(mosquito_counts ~ Temp + Humidity + Rain_lag1 + Location,
                 data = df_long, 
                 family = nbinom2)

model_5 <- glmmTMB(mosquito_counts ~ Temp + Humidity + Rain_lag1 + sin_term 
                + cos_term + Location,
                data = df_long, 
                family = nbinom2)
```

```{r}
# Model results
summary(model_1)
summary(model_2)
summary(model_3)
summary(model_4)
summary(model_5)
```

```{r}
# Final Model (5) check
simulationOutput <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model_5)
plot(simulationOutput)
```

```{r}

# Bayesian Model 
bayesian <- brm(
  formula = mosquito_counts ~ Temp + Humidity + Rain_lag1 + sin_term 
  + cos_term + Location,
  data = df_long,
  family = negbinomial(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b"),
    prior(normal(0, 5), class = "Intercept")
  ),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.97)
)

summary(bayesian)


# Model check
# Extract posterior draws
posterior_all <- as.array(bayesian)

# Trace plots 
p0 <- mcmc_trace(posterior_all, 
                 pars = c("b_Intercept","b_Temp","b_Humidity",
                          "b_Rain_lag1","b_sin_term","b_cos_term",
                          "b_LocationIlobu", "b_LocationOwode"),
                 facet_args = list(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_classic() + ggtitle("A  Trace plots")

# Density Plots
p1 <- mcmc_dens(posterior_all, 
                 pars = c("b_Intercept","b_Temp","b_Humidity",
                          "b_Rain_lag1","b_sin_term","b_cos_term",
                          "b_LocationIlobu", "b_LocationOwode"),
                 facet_args = list(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_classic() + ggtitle("B  Density plots")

# Autocorrelation plot (should drop to near zero quickly)
p2 <- mcmc_acf(posterior_all,
               pars = c("b_Intercept","b_Temp","b_Humidity",
                        "b_Rain_lag1","b_sin_term","b_cos_term",
                        "b_LocationIlobu", "b_LocationOwode"),
               lags = 15) + ggtitle("c  Autocorrelation")


# Combine
(p0 | (p1/ p2)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "MCMC Convergence Diagnostics — Bayesian Model for all Species Counts",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))
  )



# Temporal Fit plot
################################################################

# Get posterior fitted values (on response scale)
fitted_vals <- fitted(bayesian, 
                      summary = TRUE,   # returns mean + CIs
                      probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

# Bind to the original data
plot_df <- df_long %>%
  mutate(
    fitted_mean = fitted_vals[, "Estimate"],
    lower_95    = fitted_vals[, "Q2.5"],
    upper_95    = fitted_vals[, "Q97.5"]
  )

head(plot_df)


# Make the Plot
p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Time)) +   
  
  # 95% CI Ribbon — fill mapped to string for legend
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95, fill = "95% CI"), 
              alpha = 0.5) +
  
  # Fitted line — color mapped to string for legend
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted_mean, color = "Fitted", group = 1), 
            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Observed line — color mapped to string for legend
  geom_line(aes(y = mosquito_counts, color = "Observed", group = 1), 
            linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Create 3 columns for location-specific plots
  facet_wrap(~ Location, ncol = 3, labeller = label_both) +
  
  # Label the Axis
  labs(x = "Monthly", y = "Abundance") +
  
  # Add legend for the lines
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("Observed" = "black", "Fitted" = "red"),
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = c("dashed", "solid"),
                                             linewidth = c(0.8, 0.8)))
  ) +
  
  # Add 95% CI ribbon legend
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("95% CI" = "grey70"),
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 0.5))
  ) +
  
  
# Set theme
  theme_classic() +
  
  # SEt legend Position
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.85)
      )
p
```

# SPECIES SPECIFIC ANALYSIS

```{r}
data <- read_excel("C:/Users/YASMEEN/Desktop/GITHUB/Mosquito_Climate_Analysis/abundance data.xlsx")
View(data)

# Filter the needed column
data <- data %>% select(c(Time, Year, Month, Temp, Humidity, Rain_lag1, 
                          sin_term, cos_term, Cx_quequfasciatus, An_gambiae))

# Remove NAs
data <- na.omit(data)

# Scale the Numeric predictors
data <- data %>%
  mutate(across(c(Temp, Humidity, Rain_lag1), 
                ~ as.vector(scale(.))))
```



```{r}
# Cx_quequfasciatus Model
cx_bayes <- brm(
  formula = Cx_quequfasciatus ~ Temp + Humidity + Rain_lag1 + sin_term 
  + cos_term,
  data = data,
  family = negbinomial(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b"),
    prior(normal(0, 5), class = "Intercept"),
    prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = "shape")   
  ),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.97)
)

summary(cx_bayes)


# Model check
# Extract posterior draws
posterior_cx <- as.array(cx_bayes)

# Trace plots 
p0_cx <- mcmc_trace(posterior_cx, 
                 pars = c("b_Intercept","b_Temp","b_Humidity",
                          "b_Rain_lag1","b_sin_term","b_cos_term"),
                 facet_args = list(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_classic() + ggtitle("A  Trace plots")

# Density Plots
p1_cx <- mcmc_dens(posterior_cx, 
                pars = c("b_Intercept","b_Temp","b_Humidity",
                         "b_Rain_lag1","b_sin_term","b_cos_term"),
                facet_args = list(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_classic() + ggtitle("B  Density plots")

# Autocorrelation plot (should drop to near zero quickly)
p2_cx <- mcmc_acf(posterior_cx,
               pars = c("b_Intercept","b_Temp","b_Humidity",
                        "b_Rain_lag1","b_sin_term","b_cos_term"),
               lags = 15) + ggtitle("c  Autocorrelation")

p0_cx
p1_cx
p2_cx

# Combine
(p0_cx | (p1_cx/ p2_cx)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "MCMC Convergence Diagnostics — Cx_quequfasciatus Bayesian Model",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))
  )

# Temporal Fit plot
cx_fitted <- fitted(cx_bayes, summary = TRUE, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

cx_plot_df <- data %>%   # your species-level dataframe
  mutate(
    fitted_mean = cx_fitted[, "Estimate"],
    lower_95    = cx_fitted[, "Q2.5"],
    upper_95    = cx_fitted[, "Q97.5"]
  )


# Make plot

cx_plot <- ggplot(cx_plot_df, aes(x = Time)) +   
  
  # 95% CI Ribbon — fill mapped to string for legend
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95, fill = "95% CI"), 
              alpha = 0.5) +
  
  # Fitted line — color mapped to string for legend
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted_mean, color = "Fitted", group = 1), 
            linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Observed line — color mapped to string for legend
  geom_line(aes(y = Cx_quequfasciatus, color = "Observed", group = 1), 
            linewidth = 0.8) +
  
    # Label the Axis
  labs(x = "Monthly", y = "Abundance") +
  
  # Add legend for the lines
  scale_color_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("Observed" = "black", "Fitted" = "red"),
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linetype = c("dashed", "solid"),
                                             linewidth = c(0.8, 0.8)))
  ) +
  
  # Add 95% CI ribbon legend
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("95% CI" = "grey70"),
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 0.5))
  ) +
  
  # Set theme
  theme_classic() +
  
  # SEt legend Position
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.85)
  )+
  
  ggtitle("A")

cx_plot
```


```{r}
# Anopheles Model
gam_bayes <- brm(
  formula = An_gambiae ~ Temp + Humidity + Rain_lag1 + sin_term 
  + cos_term,
  data = data,
  family = negbinomial(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b"),
    prior(gamma(2, 0.1), class = shape),
    prior(normal(0, 5), class = "Intercept")
  ),
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  warmup = 1000,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  sample_prior = "yes"      # lets you compare prior and posterior
)

summary(gam_bayes)

# Model check
# Extract posterior draws
posterior_an <- as.array(gam_bayes)

# Trace plots 
p0_an <- mcmc_trace(posterior_an, 
                    pars = c("b_Intercept","b_Temp","b_Humidity",
                             "b_Rain_lag1","b_sin_term","b_cos_term"),
                    facet_args = list(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_classic() + ggtitle("A  Trace plots")

                   pars = c("b_Intercept","b_Temp","b_Humidity",
                            "b_Rain_lag1","b_sin_term","b_cos_term"),
                   facet_args = list(ncol = 2)) +
  theme_classic() + ggtitle("B  Density plots")

# Autocorrelation plot (should drop to near zero quickly)

                  pars = c("b_Intercept","b_Temp","b_Humidity",
                           "b_Rain_lag1","b_sin_term","b_cos_term"),

p0_an
p1_an
p2_an
```
